Get Remote File Modification Date

Source: R/getAnnotation.R
dot-get_remote_date.Rd

Retrieves the last modification date of a remote file from its HTTP headers. Useful for checking if cached data needs updating.

Usage

.get_remote_date(url)

Arguments

url

Character string specifying the URL to check. If NULL, returns NULL.

Value

A Date object representing the last modification time, or NA if the request fails. Returns NA if the URL is NULL or if the remote server is unreachable.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
  .get_remote_date("https://example.com/data.txt")
} # }
